notices.vendor_name: Lenox Hill Radiology & Medical Imaging Associates
notices.description: The NYC Department of Sanitation (DSNY) Health Care Facility is an occupational health facility with a medical staff that evaluates the medical condition(s) of its uniform and non-uniform employees. Evaluations include fitness for duty, safety, return-to-work, and pre-employment evaluations. DSNY is looking to hire a Contractor that can provide X-rays with Interpretations for DSNYs pre-employment screening program. This screening process is essential for candidates applying for the Sanitation Worker position, as it involves a thorough medical evaluation. During this evaluation, candidates are interviewed, and objective medical evidence, including X-rays, is required. The purpose of obtaining these X-rays is to assist the Medical Director and/or the designated medical team in determining whether the candidate meets the necessary qualifications to work for DSNY.
notices.plain: The Department of Sanitation awarded Lenox Hill Radiology & Medical Imaging Associates a contract worth $900,000 through competitive sealed bids to provide X-rays with interpretations for its pre-employment medical screening of sanitation worker candidates.

notices.short_title: 84125P0014-ESA, Roadway Eng, Data Coll, Design, Inspect & Related Srvs
notices.description: The Roadway Repair & Maintenance (RRM) division of the Department of Transportation is seeking appropriately qualified vendors to provide Roadway Engineering, Data Collection, Design, Inspection, and Related Services to assist the Department in its daily workflow and to assist in the development of projects to improve roadway pavement and drainage, to conduct studies to allow the initiation of capital projects to improve elements of the limited access arterial system; to evaluate materials and equipment proposed for Agency use; to support DOT facilities environmental and legal compliance; and other purposes as exemplified in the typlical tasks. This Procurement is subject to participation goals for New York States Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) as required by FHWA; however, there is no DBE goal set for this project. A Pre-Proposal Conference has been scheduled for September 17, 2026, at 10:00 AM through the Microsoft Teams link. Proposers who wish to attend the Conference meeting can access it by using the Link provided in the 'Prepare RFX' Section - SETUP Tab - Pre-Proposal/Pre-Bid Conference Section in PASSPort. This Request for Proposals (RFP) is released through PAS…
notices.plain: The Department of Transportation is seeking qualified vendors, chosen through competing proposals due Oct. 9, 2026, for roadway engineering, data collection, design, inspection and related services for pavement, drainage and capital project studies.
